description: This file defines the GatewayConnectivityCoordinator singleton class responsible for managing and monitoring the connection state to a gateway endpoint in an application. It handles endpoint states, maintains URL resolutions, and communicates with other components like GatewayEndpointStore and ControlChannel.

classes.name: GatewayConnectivityCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class that manages gateway endpoint connections, maintains connection state, and updates related UI or logic accordingly.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the endpoint subscription task that listens for gateway state changes.

methods.name: handleEndpointState
methods.description: Processes the received endpoint state and updates internal properties accordingly, triggering refresh actions when the endpoint URL changes.

methods.name: hostLabel
methods.description: Constructs a host label string from a URL, including port if available.
